recommendation: Keep the core narrative fix. Do not re-expand the extension contexts in core; any future context change belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack and should explicitly account for FHIR-42946 and FHIR-42949.
issue_request: FHIR-30114 was Published/Persuasive and requested expanding cqf-strengthOfRecommendation and cqf-qualityOfEvidence beyond Attachment, with the approved resolution to support application on PlanDefinition.action.repeat().
initial_application: The issue was applied to core through HL7/fhir PR #1143 and commit d639867be1, which broadened both extension contexts in source/profiles/clinicalreasoning-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. In the current source, those extension definitions are no longer present in core and the clinical reasoning pages link to extension-pack definitions through [%extensions-location%].
additional_context: The FHIR Extension Pack now owns the StructureDefinitions. Later Published/Persuasive FHIR-42946 and FHIR-42949 tightened both contexts to PlanDefinition.action. The core supporting-documentation topic still showed cqf-qualityOfEvidence on an Attachment/documentation document and described DocumentReference and RequestOrchestration.action usage, which conflicted with the current extension definitions. A Zulip discussion from the issue's origin supports the PlanDefinition-action interpretation.
reconciliation: Updated source/clinicalreasoning-topics-supporting-documentation.html to show both extensions on a PlanDefinition action and to describe grading evidence/recommendations on that action. Updated source/clinicalreasoning-module.html extension descriptions and common-use-case row to say PlanDefinition actions, removing the broader artifact/recommendation wording.
source_changes: source/clinicalreasoning-topics-supporting-documentation.html: replaced the Attachment/documentation example and broad DocumentReference/RequestOrchestration prose with PlanDefinition.action usage for both extensions.
source/clinicalreasoning-module.html: narrowed the cqf-qualityOfEvidence and cqf-strengthOfRecommendation extension summaries and common-use-case row to PlanDefinition actions.
